title: Senior AI Product Engineer: 24/7 Production Launch Support for Legal Operations AI Platform
description:
We’re a law firm, and we’re taking our Legal Operations AI MVP into production. It replaces a fair amount of our legacy legal system. We’d like a senior AI product engineer on call around the clock for the first week, so that when something breaks (and something always does), someone who understands both the AI and the full stack can jump in quickly.

What we built
It isn’t a ChatGPT wrapper. It’s an internal AI operations platform that works with our documents, emails and existing systems to cut down on repetitive admin work. Day to day, the team uses it for:
Client and matter intake
Document and email summarisation
Pulling out dates, parties, obligations and action items
Building matter timelines
Searching our internal knowledge base
Drafting first-pass emails and notes
Routing tasks to the right people

Every answer is grounded in RAG over our own documents (embeddings, vector search and semantic search) and comes with source citations, so people can see where it came from. Retrieval respects matter-level permissions.

Under the hood:
AI layer: model-agnostic. Different tasks go to different models, including OpenAI GPT models, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Grok, Groq and Llama, partly through OpenRouter and the Vercel AI SDK, with fallback when a provider goes down.
Agents: AI agents use tool calling and MCP to take actions. Structured JSON outputs get validated before anything happens.
Business rules: deterministic rules sit apart from the AI. Anything sensitive or uncertain waits for human review.
Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL and AWS, with private S3 storage, background jobs, queues and webhooks. A few older PHP/WordPress pieces are still connected, along with integrations into email, our matter-management software, billing and Stripe.

What we need from you
For seven days from go-live, be reachable at any hour. In practice that means:
Monitoring: keep an eye on errors and logs, LLM usage and costs, and any AI actions that failed or came back uncertain.
Fixing: when something goes wrong, work out why and fix it. That might be: a model API outage or rate limit; a document that won’t ingest or OCR properly; retrieval pulling the wrong sources; an agent workflow getting stuck; a webhook or queue backing up; someone who can’t access a matter they should be able to (or can access one they shouldn’t)
Escalating: some things we need to hear about straight away: possible data leakage; prompt injection, including instructions hidden inside documents; hallucinations or answers stated more confidently than the sources support; confidential data heading to an AI provider it shouldn’t
Legal work has very little tolerance for confidently wrong output. The system is meant to say “I don’t know” rather than guess, and we want to confirm it actually does.
Incident log: keep a short note of each incident: what happened, why, and what you did.
End-of-week summary: what held up, what didn’t, and what you’d prioritise next.

Response times
Critical (system down, or anything touching security or confidentiality): acknowledge within 30 minutes, day or night.
Everything else: within 4 hours.

Terms
$10/hr, billed only for time you actually spend on alerts, investigating and fixing. One week from go-live, with the date agreed together. Our usual rules still apply: no confidential data to unapproved AI providers; least-privilege access; audit logging; human sign-off on sensitive actions. If it goes well, we’d like to keep working together on the next phases.

Who this suits
Ideally you’ve built and run production AI or SaaS products yourself, not just prototypes. Technical founders, founding engineers, forward deployed engineers and full-stack AI engineers would all fit well. A few things are a bonus but not required: Trust & safety, abuse detection or prompt injection testing; Voice, transcription or other multimodal AI work (ElevenLabs, Runway and so on); Experimenting with local models, fine-tuning or Unsloth
